coder_notes: S-Gboxin is registered as Biological but described as a small-molecule OXPHOS inhibitor taken in capsules. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention; listed because the text says S-Gboxin is added to standard RT/TMZ. The arm title says 'during (or without) standard treatment' and inclusion mentions relapse or progression while the rationale is added to RT/TMZ, so treatment setting is unclear. H3 K27M appears in conditions (diffuse midline glioma) but the trial recruits 'regardless of mutation status', so no biomarker is an entry requirement.
